implementation_summary: router.ts: 11 new Route variants (audit-new, audits, audit, audit-version, audit-review, audit-export, audit-share, audit-helpers, audit-settings, audit-shortlist, helper-sign-in) and matching PATHS. The audit paths copy AUDIT_PATHS because screens import the router and a router import of saved-api could make a cycle; a test pins them. New addresses: /audit-settings (the settings screen) and /helper (Helper sign-in). matchRoute decodes ids; an unreadable or empty id, or a version that is not a plain positive integer, is not-found. isCheckRoute and readsAddressParam were not changed, so they are false for every audit route. App.tsx: imports and renders the screens (AuditStartScreen, SavedAuditsScreen, AuditHistoryScreen, AnalysisScreen, ReviewDocumentsScreen, ExportDocumentsScreen, PreviewShareScreen, HelpersScreen, HelperSignInScreen, ShortlistScreen). The audit-settings route shows DocumentSettingsScreen and AuditAiModelsPanel together. Tab titles added for audit routes. No step bar for audit routes.
tests_proposed: wizard-e2e navigation through /audits/new and /audits once the runner audit routes exist
risks: TopBar.tsx (outside my ownership) ends its breadcrumb chain with 'Visibility' for any route it does not know, so audit routes would show a 'Visibility' breadcrumb. It needs audit labels, or the audit route names added to NO_CRUMBS.

RewriteReview is not mounted. It needs a PageContent prop, and the only place with one is inside AnalysisScreen's PageContentView, which is not in my files. Whoever owns AnalysisScreen or PageContentView should mount it there.
No link or nav entry points to /audits, /audit-settings or /helper yet. The routes work by address; TopBar and CommandPalette are not mine.
The new routes' tab titles are not in PUBLIC_TITLES in title.ts, so the pages are marked noindex, which suits private audit screens.
/audits/new is matched before /audits/:id, so a Website Audit whose id is literally 'new' cannot be opened by its address.
The T-211 barrel check covers only screens/audit; ReportScreen and other older screens still import values from '@qa/types'.
handoff: Add Website Audit breadcrumb labels or nav links in TopBar.tsx and CommandPalette.tsx. Mount RewriteReview inside the page content view in the results screens. Dependency changes for FE-191 are added by the orchestrator.
